      "sourceAnalysis": [
        "All12 owned paths are read. Native EmptyTrash now gathers the Trash ID, direct-child IDs and known message IDs before dispatching one primitive. EmptyFolder HardDelete with delete_sub_folders=true preserves the target folder while deleting its contents; the old C++ separate DeleteMessages/DeleteFolder initiation is removed.",
        "C++ captures local message headers and strong listener/folder references. Remote success re-enumerates local child folders, propagates each local deletion, then calls LocalDeleteMessages on captured headers. ScopeExit reports its local result to an existing URL listener even when a local guard returns early. This is ordered reconciliation, not an atomic remote/local transaction or proof that concurrent newly arrived headers are included.",
        "The bridge converts ID strings, retains the safe listener and detaches moz_task. Its Ok return indicates dispatch, not remote success. OnStartRunningUrl occurs after a successful dispatch and before EmptyTrash returns; completion comes later. The review aspiration that no listener callback run before successful initiating return is not fully adopted by this source.",
        "Historical3972 failure lambda dereferences aListener without checking it, although success/initial callbacks allow it to be absent. Exact historical and current nsIMsgFolder IDL show null is a URL listener; the existing protocol test and current FolderCommands use null. The accepted failure callback now checks aListener and returns NS_OK if absent. Historical null-error exposure is a static concern, not a reproduced crash or a current unguarded failure.",
        "Rust chooses EmptyFolder when version>=Exchange2010. Older versions first call DeleteFolder directly for nonempty child IDs, reporting any error, then call delete_messages only when message_ids is nonempty. If no messages remain, the branch ends without success/failure notification. This exists in the owned and accepted source and can skip C++ local reconciliation/URL stop for an empty or folder-only old-server Trash; no such execution ran.",
        "IDL says useLegacyFallback is true iff the workaround was used. The fallback message deletion success actually returns No, converted to false; empty-message fallback gives no success argument. Current native EmptyTrash ignores this bool. The recursive request policy is explicit in Rust and IDL, but the flag documentation is not proof of emitted values.",
        "DoEraseFolder adds folder-ID logging by zipping folder IDs with response messages. It tolerates ErrorItemNotFound and otherwise propagates checked response errors, but does not compare response count with requested IDs. If parsed counts differ, missing pairs or extra response errors can be skipped before returning success. delete_messages supplies a concrete count-before-zip counterexample; this is conditional static analysis, not a malformed-server run.",
        "Fake EmptyFolder support adds a response template/dispatch branch/handler and emptyRemoteFolderById. That helper deletes only direct messages and direct child-folder entries; deleteRemoteFolderById does not recurse into descendants or their messages. It retains the target folder. The handler ignores requested delete attributes, emits DeleteFolderResponseMessage rather than the vendor test EmptyFolderResponseMessage, and its missing-folder comment names ErrorFolderNotFound while code emits ErrorItemNotFound. These limit fake fidelity; no parser-failure inference is made.",
        "Owned fake-server code has no new result assertions. The pre-existing soft-delete test empties one child folder with null listener, waits for the local child list to clear, syncs, and asserts the known remote child is gone. The current setup defaults to Exchange2013. This does not directly check unknown unsynced items, multiple nesting levels, child messages, pre-2010 fallback, callback count/order, listener error or Trash survival after restart. Separate vendor tests assert XML equality only.",
        "Manual style/naming: the patch consistently corrects Failible to Fallible across native declarations/definitions/callers, uses capacity hints, captures nsCOMPtr/RefPtr ownership and keeps collection/remote/local phases separated by comments and blank lines. The Rust marker trait shares operation construction while preserving Delete versus Empty target policy. The legacy early return on error must retain completion; neither that local pattern nor accepted fixture forEach uses establish a global syntax rule.",
        "Full D268961 has20 actual submitted inlines including the old Cargo locator, no summary edits. Author moved version selection into Rust despite enumerating IDs on the fast path, added fallible listeners/recursive documentation and corrected Fallible. Reviewer callback aspirations and Done markers are not universal accepted rules; the IDL flag mismatch and empty-message branch remain source facts.",

C++ review was explicitly limited; Rust acceptance is separate, and BenC later resigned before landing.
